## Security

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Apple presents evidence against former employee accused of stealing data for OpenAI
Apple alleges that a former employee now at OpenAI stole confidential trade secrets including circuit schematics and internal engineering tools, and destroyed evidence after learning of Apple's investigation. Apple claims OpenAI was aware of the employee's access to sensitive data and is seeking to block OpenAI from hardware development using Apple's technology.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Former employee Chang Liu at OpenAI allegedly used Apple trade secrets including circuit schematic</li>
<li>Apple alleges Liu destroyed evidence in June with assistance from OpenAI colleague Yu-Ting Peng</li>
<li>Liu allegedly exploited authentication bug to maintain access to Apple files</li>
<li>400+ former Apple employees now work at OpenAI, suggesting additional implications</li>
<li>Apple seeking preliminary injunction and expedited discovery</li>
</ul>

Sources: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/31/apple-shares-shocking-evidence-against-former-employee-accused-of-stealing-company-data-for-openai/) <span class="src-badge src-research">AI Web Searched</span>, [The Times of India](https://news.google.?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>
